subject: humanities
passage: Kintsugi is a Japanese method of repairing broken pottery with lacquer dusted with powdered gold. Instead of hiding the cracks, the ______ them, treating the damage as part of the object's history.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "The method" is the subject of the sentence and "highlights" is its verb. No punctuation should separate a subject from its verb, so nothing goes between "method" and "highlights."
explanation.A: Correct. The subject "the method" flows straight into its verb "highlights" with no punctuation.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A single comma can't separate a subject from its verb.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A semicolon joins two independent clauses; here it would cut the subject off from its verb.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause, and "Instead of hiding the cracks, the method" is not one.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
